scriptLines: gender = case( lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male', 'Male',                  lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female', 'Female',                  toString(null())),

phone = case( length(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', '')) == 10,                    regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''),                  length(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', '')) == 11 && startsWith(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''), '1'),                    substring(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 2, 10),                  toString(null())),

derivedColumn1 derive(date_of_birth = case(   regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{1,2}, [0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM d, yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(concat(substring(trim(date_of_birth), 1, 6),                   iif(toInteger(substring(trim(date_of_birth), 7, 2)) > 26, '19', '20'),                   substring(trim(date_of_birth), 7, 2)), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   toDate(null()) )) ~> derivedColumn2

derivedColumn2 derive(date_of_birth = iif(!isNull(date_of_birth)                            && date_of_birth >= toDate('1900-01-01')                            && date_of_birth <= currentDate(),                          date_of_birth, toDate(null())),

insurance_provider = case(                          ins_key == 'medicaid', 'Medicaid',                          ins_key == 'medicare', 'Medicare',                          ins_key == 'cigna' || ins_key == 'cignahealth', 'Cigna',                          ins_key == 'unitedhealth' || ins_key == 'uhc', 'UnitedHealth',                          ins_key == 'bluecross', 'BlueCross',                          ins_key == 'aetna' || ins_key == 'aetnainc' || ins_key == 'aetnaa', 'Aetna',                          ins_key == 'selfpay', 'Self-Pay',                          toString(null()))) ~> derivedColumn3
